name: dataviz-toolkit
description: Edikted Dataviz platform tools — query data, manage dashboards, refresh sources, deploy reports
long_description: Provides MCP tools for the Edikted Dataviz platform: list/describe tables, run SQL against DuckDB, list/create/save canvas dashboards, trigger extracts, upload dynamic reports, send PDF reports via email. On first run the server prompts for per-user credentials (stored locally, never in chat).
